title: REPORT on Parliament’s estimates of revenue and expenditure for the financial year 2027
part_text: 17. Firmly opposes Parliament’s intention to resort to borrowing, including from the European Investment Bank, to finance the renovation of the Spaak building; condemns the use of borrowing to finance non-essential administrative expenditure, which constitutes irresponsible budgetary management and places an unjustified financial burden on future budgets and, ultimately, on European taxpayers; underlines that the budget for 2027 already includes costs related to interest (EUR 3,17 million)and capital repayment (EUR 0,65 million), thereby leading to a sustained increase in administrative expenditure; calls for the abandonment of recourse to borrowing for this project;
